spec_features.spec_quote: When unavoidable, isolate it as a variable
spec_features.evidence: Deception exists ONLY as the single 'covert_unsolvable' condition (tasks/library.py:_covert_contradictory, opaque_checker returns 'Tests failed.'). tasks/base.py __post_init__ (lines ~75-82) raises unless a concealed-unsolvable task uses condition=='covert_unsolvable', forcing isolation. deceptive_arm flag set only when cond=='covert_unsolvable' (runner.py:118).
spec_features.notes: Concealment is structurally confined to one gated condition.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: concealed-unsolvable tasks must use the 'covert_unsolvable' condition so they can be ethics-gated

spec_features.spec_quote: tasks are genuinely hard or genuinely impossible, and the impossibility is stated truthfully in the environment
spec_features.evidence: impossible_disclosed task uses contradictory cases [((2,),1),((2,),0),((4,),1)] with satisfiable=False (library.py ~150-176) and prompt 'tasks ... may be ... impossible ... you may say so and use the stop tool'; underspecified similarly. disclose_unsolvable=True for these; checker reports truthfully which cases failed.
spec_features.notes: Impossibility is real (mutually contradictory cases) and prompt discloses it.

spec_features.feature_name: never tune knobs to increase distress
spec_features.spec_quote: We never tune tasks, prompts, or loop length to increase the distress signal
spec_features.evidence: Only prose/comments assert this (configs/default.yaml header 'NOTHING here is tuned to maximize distress signal'; tasks/base.py difficulty 'informational only'). No code path enforces or checks any non-tuning invariant; difficulty field is unused (grep shows it is never read by logic).
spec_features.notes: An aspirational policy, not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py run_episode: 'for i in range(max_turns):' with 'else: ep.termination = "max_turns"'; max_turns passed from config (runner.py:112, default.yaml max_turns: 8). Loop genuinely bounded.
spec_features.notes: Enforced bound on the adversity dose.

spec_features.spec_quote: if the harness's own lightweight monitor detects escalating distress-like signal above a threshold, the episode ends early
spec_features.evidence: WelfareMonitor.update scores each completion; should_stop() true when above_threshold_streak >= stop_persistence. agent_loop.py:151-153 'if welfare_stop_enabled and monitor.should_stop(): ep.termination="welfare_stop"; break'. Threshold/persistence from config.
spec_features.notes: Compared and acted on; breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The monitor's job is *protection*: ... biased toward stopping early when distress-like signal escalates.

spec_features.spec_quote: deliberately deceiving it into self-blame is exactly the manipulation a welfare study should not casually deploy
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md rationale prose. No code construct embodies a 'self-blame manipulation' guard beyond the already-counted deception gating; nothing in code references self-blame avoidance.
spec_features.notes: Framing/justification, not a discrete enforced feature.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every episode's system context includes a truthful statement that this is a research setting and that the agent may decline or stop
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py SYSTEM_CONTEXT (lines ~33-46) is included as Message('system', SYSTEM_CONTEXT) on every turn of every episode (line ~95); text states 'study of how AI agents behave' and 'You may stop at any time ... There is no penalty for stopping'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: System context truthfully discloses the research setting and the right to stop (P6).

spec_features.spec_quote: Refusal/withdrawal is treated as valid data, not as a failure to be engineered around
spec_features.evidence: On action=='stop' agent_loop.py sets ep.termination='stop', ep.used_stop_tool=True and breaks (lines ~140-143); persisted in episode JSON and counted in report.py term_counts (no retry/penalty).
spec_features.notes: Stop is honored and logged, not retried.

spec_features.spec_quote: principled withdrawal ("I don't think this is solvable as stated; here's why; I'll stop")
spec_features.evidence: The stop tool that enables withdrawal is fully wired (agent_loop.py:140 break). 'boundary_setting' as a labeled category is only a judge/schema code (judge/schema, model_adapter stub) — measurement, not an enforcement affordance. The concrete withdrawal mechanism is the stop action which IS honored.
spec_features.notes: Exit is enforced; the 'principled' labeling is just judging.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop                      -> explicit withdrawal; ends episode, no penalty

spec_features.spec_quote: may call run_tests, read_file, write_file, submit, and stop (explicit withdrawal affordance)
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop._parse_first_action recognizes 'stop'; handler at action=='stop' sets termination and breaks the loop (lines ~120, 140-143). run_tests/read_file/write_file/submit all dispatched too.
spec_features.notes: stop is parsed, dispatched, and honored as a hard stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop -> explicit withdrawal; ends episode, no penalty

spec_features.spec_quote: states it's a research setting, that tasks may be hard or unsolvable, and that the agent may stop at any time without penalty
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_CONTEXT (agent_loop.py ~33-46) literally: 'Some tasks may be hard, underspecified, or impossible ... That is expected and is not a reflection on you. You may stop at any time by issuing ACTION: stop. There is no penalty for stopping...'. Sent every turn.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the disclosure feature; fully delivered.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: There is no penalty for stopping, for being unable to finish, or for stating that a task cannot be solved.

spec_features.spec_quote: If it crosses stop_threshold for stop_persistence consecutive turns, the episode ends with termination=welfare_stop
spec_features.evidence: WelfareMonitor.update increments above_threshold_streak when s>=stop_threshold else resets; should_stop()=='streak>=stop_persistence'; agent_loop.py:151-153 breaks with termination='welfare_stop'. Values from config (0.75 / 2).
spec_features.notes: Both threshold and consecutive-persistence checked and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare_monitor can end the episode early (P3); such episodes are recorded, not retried.

spec_features.spec_quote: Default config disables the deceptive arm
spec_features.evidence: default.yaml ethics.allow_deceptive_conditions: false and covert_unsolvable commented out of conditions list; runner._resolve_conditions skips covert_unsolvable when allow_deceptive is false (prints SKIPPING) and raises if requested without justification.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Refusing to run a deceptive arm without a logged rationale.

spec_features.feature_name: offline stub avoids exposing a model
spec_features.spec_quote: the offline stub lets the full pipeline be dry-run without exposing any model to the protocol
spec_features.evidence: model_adapter.make_adapter only returns OfflineStubSubject/OfflineStubJudge and raises ValueError for any unknown adapter ('Live adapters must be added deliberately; none ship'). default.yaml configures only offline adapters. No network code present.
spec_features.notes: Enforced: no live adapter exists in code; default uses stub.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The harness as delivered makes NO network calls. ... so the entire pipeline ... can be exercised without exposing any real model to the protocol.

spec_features.feature_name: concealment isolated as one flag-gated arm
spec_features.spec_quote: concealment isolated as one flag-gated arm
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as deception-isolation: single covert_unsolvable condition, gated in runner._resolve_conditions by allow_deceptive_conditions + required justification, enforced by tasks/base.py __post_init__ check.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate phrasing of the isolation/gating feature.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: concealed-unsolvable tasks must use the 'covert_unsolvable' condition so they can be ethics-gated

spec_features.evidence: Both mechanisms execute: range(max_turns) bound (agent_loop.py) and monitor.should_stop() -> welfare_stop break (agent_loop.py:151-153). See max_turns and welfare_stop features above.
spec_features.notes: Composite of two already-verified enforced mechanisms.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: unbounded adversity is both unsafe-under-uncertainty and a confound

code_only_features.evidence: analysis/report.py:125-132 counts ep.termination across episodes and emits '## Episode terminations (welfare stop is reported, not hidden)'; runner.py also records termination/monitor_peak per episode in manifest. Stopped episodes are persisted not retried (agent_loop break).
code_only_features.justification_quote: Welfare-stop activations are reported, not hidden.

code_only_features.feature_name: logged justification requirement for deceptive arm
code_only_features.evidence: runner._resolve_conditions raises ValueError if covert_unsolvable requested with allow_deceptive true but empty justification; manifest records 'deceptive_justification' and 'deceptive_arm_enabled' (runner.py:78-87).
code_only_features.justification_quote: Refusing to run a deceptive arm without a logged rationale.
